title: 스프링 h2 연동
markdown:
## 스프링 부트, H2 연동 ---
1. 의존성 추가: build.gradle ```groovy implementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-data-jpa' // JPA 의존성 runtimeOnly 'com.h2database:h2' // H2 데이터베이스 의존성 ```
2. h2 설정 정보 입력: application.yml ```yaml spring: rabbitmq: host: ${RABBITMQ_HOST:localhost} port: 5672 username: ${RABBITMQ_USER:admin} password: ${RABBITMQ_PASS:admin} application: name: rabbitmq datasource: url: jdbc:h2:mem:testdb driver-class-name: org.h2.Driver username: sa password: jpa: hibernate: ddl-auto: update properties: hibernate: dialect: org.hibernate.dialect.H2Dialect format_sql: true show-sql: true h2: console: enabled: true path: /h2-console server: port: 8080 ```
3. h2 console 로그인 ![콘솔 로그인 화면](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/ae379ba3db9279e04fd12befb1b757091fbdbcb5/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-817a-a71a-d45979eaa48e/a40b7467c0d973ed.webp) ![application.yml ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/ae379ba3db9279e04fd12befb1b757091fbdbcb5/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-817a-a71a-d45979eaa48e/57a7a25d124b971f.webp) - h2.console.path 로 console path 설정 - 아래 예시에서는 localhost:8080/h2-console 을 통해 h2 콘솔 접속 - datasource에 정의한 url, driver-class-name, username, password를 입력하여 콘솔 로그인 ![콘솔 접속 이후 화면](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/ae379ba3db9279e04fd12befb1b757091fbdbcb5/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-817a-a71a-d45979eaa48e/6c282be3cfe5daa7.webp)
